memory_candidates: In this Lean codebase le_or_lt is not an available identifier; lt_or_ge with the branches reordered is the working two-way split and is what the RaySummary modules already use.

When a plan's Lean Challenge Statements block pins a binder the proof does not read, keep the binder and silence linter.unusedVariables with a scoped set_option ... in plus a comment naming the reason. Renaming to _h would change the pinned signature, which plan-compliance.md's Statement Fidelity forbids. Six sites in the RaySummary family already use this convention.

The in-source linter.style.longFile baseline must equal the file's own round-up to the next hundred, not a forward-looking ceiling, so a growing module needs the baseline raised once per phase rather than set once to its final value.

git-commit-scoped.sh's pre-commit gate includes typst-sync-check.sh Check 2, which compares typst/generated/status.typ's committed line counts against a live regeneration. Any .lean line-count change trips it; the fix is bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix and adding typst/generated/status.typ to the same commit's pathspec list.
